summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K announcing organisational changes and leadership appointments. The company formalised its structure into two divisions—North America and International—and appointed Phill Wood as CEO of the International Division, Rafael Carrasco as CEO of North America, and Matt Jochim as Group Chief Transformation Officer. These are routine management appointments and structural updates, not a special-situation event. No financial terms, share prices, or transaction details are involved. The filing is informational and does not trigger any special-situation classification. No advisors or boards recommendations are mentioned. The event is typical corporate governance and operational alignment, with no market-moving transactional element.
